title: 5-Amino- and 6-amino-uracils in the synthesis of various heterocycles as therapeutic agents: a review
content:

5-Amino- and 6-amino-uracil derivatives are used as precursors in the synthesis of various heterocyclic compounds, which have attracted great interest because of their potent biological activities and therapeutic uses.
